name: Inshore
alt: Smiling angler in a cap and sunglasses holding a snook on the boat
card: Redfish, snook and trout in the bay, with grouper and snapper in the mix.
lead: Fishing inside Tampa Bay for the fish it's known for, with grouper and snapper in the mix on the right day.
targeting: Redfish, snook, trout, plus grouper and snapper in the bay
options: 4 hours ($600), 6 hours ($750) or 8 hours ($950). 4-hour trips leave at 8 a.m. or 1 p.m.
guests: 1 to 6 (up to 4 at the base price, then $75 per extra guest)

name: Redfish
rowAlt: Smiling angler holding a redfish in front of the mangroves
alt: Angler in a camo shirt holding a redfish over the bay
card: Your first red, or the trophy you've been chasing.
lead: Catch your first redfish, or go after the trophy red you've always wanted.
options: Booked as an Inshore trip: 4 hours ($600), 6 hours ($750) or 8 hours ($950)
guests: 1 to 6 (up to 4 at the base price, then $75 per extra guest)

name: Snook
alt: Angler kneeling on the deck with a big snook
card: Snook of all sizes, right here in Tampa Bay.
lead: Tampa Bay has a strong snook fishery, with fish of all sizes.
options: Booked as an Inshore trip: 4 hours ($600), 6 hours ($750) or 8 hours ($950)
guests: 1 to 6 (up to 4 at the base price, then $75 per extra guest)

name: Tarpon
alt: Angler leaning over the side of the boat with a tarpon at the surface
card: Tampa Bay is one of the best places to hook a tarpon.
lead: Every summer, migrating tarpon pour into the area. We fish for them around the bridges and the passes, and sometimes along the beaches.
options: 4 hours ($750), 6 hours ($900) or 8 hours ($1,150). Season runs April 1 to August 31
guests: 1 to 4, ages 10 and up (up to 2 at the base price, then $75 per extra guest)

name: Shark
alt: Two anglers on the boat holding up a shark
card: Go after some of the biggest predators in Tampa Bay.
lead: Take on some of the biggest predators in Tampa Bay.
targeting: Blacktip, bonnethead, bull, tiger, lemon and hammerhead sharks
guests: 1 to 6 (up to 4 at the base price, then $75 per extra guest)

name: Nearshore
alt: Angler on the dock at sunset holding a red grouper and a hogfish
card: Snapper, grouper, grunts, mackerel and sheepshead.
lead: From the mouth of Tampa Bay out to about nine miles. We bottom fish for grouper and snapper, and you can run into blackfin tuna, kingfish, cobia and the odd wahoo.
targeting: Grouper, snapper, grunts, mackerel and sheepshead, plus blackfin tuna, cobia and the occasional wahoo
guests: 1 to 6 (up to 4 at the base price, then $75 per extra guest)

name: Grouper
alt: Young angler holding a gag grouper on the boat
card: Strong fish that pull hard and eat well.
lead: Test yourself against grouper, strong fish that pull hard and taste great.
options: 4 hours ($550 afternoon, $650 morning), 6 hours ($750 afternoon, $800 morning) or 8 hours ($1,000)
guests: 1 to 6 (up to 4 at the base price, then $75 per extra guest)

name: Offshore
rowAlt: Capt. William Ashmore holding a hogfish offshore
alt: Young angler holding a grouper offshore
card: Past the beaches and into the Gulf for bigger fish.
lead: This trip starts where the nearshore trip ends, nine miles out and beyond, for bottom fish while we keep an eye out for pelagics.
targeting: Bottom fish, plus pelagics when they show up

name: Crappie
alt: A pile of crappie from a lake trip near Kissimmee
card: Lake trips around Kissimmee for new and experienced anglers.
lead: Freshwater trips on the lakes around Kissimmee, good for new and experienced anglers.
